CIS Security Assessment — How to Read the Heatmaps:
c(p) → 0 (red, top-left): constraint forces cancel out — dark zone. Fix by adding an orthogonal constraint.
λ_min(g) → 0 (red, bottom-right): unconstrained direction exists. Fill with additional constraint.
|∇·Π| peak (red, bottom-left): constraint force discontinuity — missing executor location. Add constraint here.
||Π|| (top-right): total constraint force magnitude. High force + low c(p) = two constraints fighting each other.
Hover over any heatmap to see exact values at that point.
